project_type: Next.js 14 App Router portfolio website with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion
build_system: Next.js with pnpm as package manager
test_framework: Next.js build validation (no unit tests required for this static portfolio)
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build to confirm the site compiles without errors. Run pnpm dev to confirm the dev server starts.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22 available. Full internet access (OPEN_INTERNET). No Docker needed for this project.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines.
key_patterns: Next.js 14 App Router with app/ directory, Tailwind CSS v3 for styling, Framer Motion for animations, TypeScript throughout. Dark mode by default with neon yellow/green accent (#E4F12D). Unsplash images for placeholders.
directory_structure: Standard Next.js 14 App Router: app/ for routes and layouts, components/ for reusable UI components, public/ for static assets, tailwind.config.ts for theme configuration
